description:
Download the NIST PKITS test suite and commit the DER certificate and CRL fixtures to the repository.

Source: https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/pki-testing (PKITS zip download)
The ZIP contains a Data/ directory with Certificates/ and CRLs/ subdirectories.

Commit location: pkix-path/tests/pkits/certs/ and pkix-path/tests/pkits/crls/

Also commit a pkix-path/tests/pkits/README.md (this is an exception to the no-markdown rule — it documents the fixture provenance) containing:
  - Source URL
  - SHA-256 of the ZIP file downloaded
  - Date downloaded
  - How to verify: sha256sum instructions

The PKITS trust anchor certificate is TrustAnchorRootCertificate.crt — this is the root against which all PKITS chains are validated.

Do NOT commit the ZIP itself — only the individual DER files. This keeps git history clean and avoids committing a large binary blob.

This issue has no code dependencies and can be done before any other epic.
title: PKITS: obtain and commit DER certificate fixtures
